title: Polynomial growth is false for both diagonal and off-diagonal readings
exact_target: Let $W(k)$ be the diagonal two-color van der Waerden number: the least $N$ forcing a monochromatic $k$-term arithmetic progression in every two-coloring of $\{1,\ldots,N\}$. Is $W(k)$ bounded by a polynomial in $k$?
